title: Health bar
prompt: The robot's health bar at (0, 0) is max_width wide when health is full. Return the Rect2 to draw for the current hp: the same height, but only as wide as the fraction of health left. Half health is half the width.
signature: func solve(max_width, height, hp, max_hp) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(max_width, height, hp, max_hp) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(0, 0, max_width, height)
hints: The fraction is hp divided by max_hp.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

solution:
func solve(max_width, height, hp, max_hp) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(0, 0, max_width * hp / max_hp, height)
